_meta.purpose: Replicable structure for ONE social media creative. Each image gets its own CREATIVE_DNA.json file. LLMs reverse-engineer or author this from a reference image + brief, then merge with BRAND_DNA.json at render time.
_meta.file_location: Same folder as the creative asset and prompt (e.g. instagram/, carousel/).

merge_rules.color_resolution: See skills/brand-social-creative-pipeline/references/prompt-merge.md — never pass creative hex to image prompts

llm_workflow: 1. Receive reference image and/or creative brief.
2. Read BRAND_DNA.json for invariant brand rules.
3. Analyze the reference: map every visual zone, text block, hero, and UI element.
4. Write a new {slug}.CREATIVE_DNA.json following this schema exactly.
5. At render time: merge brand_dna + creative_dna → image prompt or compositor spec.

concept.topic: string — what this creative is about

schema.structure_type: string — layout archetype for this specific image, e.g. stat-hero-human-product | editorial-search-hero | myth-truth-list | split-comparison

{zone_name}.position: top-left | top-right | upper-third | center | center-left | center-right | center-lower | bottom-left | bottom-right | footer

visual_identity.background_mode: light | dark | primary — layout tone; resolved to brand.visual_identity at merge (light→background, dark→primary_dark, primary→primary)
visual_identity.background: DEPRECATED at render — reference/documentation hex only; ignored at merge
visual_identity.background_treatment: string — texture only (gradient direction, grain, blur); base hex always from brand via background_mode
visual_identity.primary_accent: DEPRECATED at render — use brand secondary_light; role reference only
visual_identity.secondary_accent: DEPRECATED at render — use brand revenue; role reference only
visual_identity.text: DEPRECATED at render — use brand text or text_on_dark per background_mode
visual_identity.text_on_dark: DEPRECATED at render — use brand text_on_dark
visual_identity.style: string — creative-specific style descriptor (layout mood, not palette)

elements.type: headline | subheadline | stat | stat_label | card | search_bar | cta_button | logo | url | badge | icon_row | phone_ui | prop

style.color: DEPRECATED at render — resolved from brand by element.type + background_mode
style.background: DEPRECATED at render — resolved from brand by element.type

effects.halo_color: DEPRECATED at render — use brand ai
effects.glow_accent: DEPRECATED at render — use brand secondary_light

replication.structure_summary: string — 1-2 sentences describing layout for LLM re-use
must_preserve: string — structural elements that define this creative
variable_slots: string — what can change per variant while keeping structure
